text: The Patriots face Jacksonville this Sunday at 1 PM ET with several roster moves in flux: rookie tight end Eli Raridon has returned to practice, offering some optimism at the position, while the team signed linebacker Jose Ramirez to the 53-man roster from the practice squad and linebacker Benton Whitley to the practice squad, but those moves came after placing safety Dell Pettus on injured reserve and dealing with a significant injury to starting right guard Mike Onwenu, whose broken right ankle will require the offense to adjust up front ahead of the trip to Everbank Stadium. While the Patriots' offense hasn't yet regained the rhythm from their Super Bowl championship season, the defense demonstrated real capability in their previous outing, though head coach Mike Vrabel and the team will need to balance protecting Drake Maye while keeping the Jacksonville defense from controlling the line of scrimmage.
